questions.text: What is a direct prompt injection attack?
options: Injecting malicious code directly into the model's underlying source code and configuration files
Crafting input that makes the model ignore its instructions and follow the attacker
Physically tampering with the GPU memory chips during the inference process
Sending far too many API requests at once to overload the server
questions.explanation: A direct prompt injection attack involves crafting input that tricks the model into ignoring its system prompt or safety guidelines and instead following attacker-controlled instructions embedded in the user input.

questions.text: Which of the following are effective defenses against jailbreaking attempts? Select all that apply.
options: Input filtering combined with output validation layers
System prompt hardening with clear boundary instructions
Simply making the model much larger so that it eventually becomes fully immune to any attack
Using a secondary classifier to detect adversarial prompts
questions.explanation: Effective jailbreaking defenses include input/output filtering, hardening system prompts with explicit boundaries, and deploying secondary classifiers to flag adversarial inputs. Simply making a model larger does not make it immune to prompt attacks.

questions.text: What is data poisoning in the context of LLM security?
options: Encrypting the training data so that the model can never learn anything useful from it at all
Intentionally adding malicious or biased examples to training data to corrupt the model
Removing all sensitive information from the training dataset before use
Converting the training data into a format incompatible with the tokenizer
questions.explanation: Data poisoning involves injecting carefully crafted malicious or biased examples into the training data, causing the model to learn harmful behaviors, produce biased outputs, or create hidden backdoors that can be exploited later.

questions.text: What is the primary role of guardrails in an LLM application?
options: To speed up inference by reducing the total number of tokens the model generates each time
To enforce safety policies by filtering or blocking inputs and outputs that break rules
To compress the model so that it uses noticeably less memory at runtime
To automatically retrain the model from scratch whenever it produces any errors
questions.explanation: Guardrails act as a safety layer around an LLM, enforcing policies by inspecting and filtering both inputs and outputs. They can block harmful content, prevent data leakage, and ensure outputs comply with application-specific rules.

questions.text: How does Constitutional AI (CAI) differ from RLHF in aligning model behavior?
options: CAI uses human labelers for every single response, while RLHF is instead fully automated end to end
CAI swaps human feedback for written principles the model uses to self-critique
RLHF is a much newer and more advanced technique than CAI in every respect
CAI trains the model without any fine-tuning step whatsoever
questions.explanation: Constitutional AI reduces reliance on human feedback by providing the model with a set of explicit principles (a constitution). The model uses these principles to critique and revise its own outputs, whereas RLHF relies on human evaluators to rank outputs and train a reward model.

questions.text: Ce este un atac direct de injectare a promptului?
options: Injectarea de cod malitios direct in codul sursa de baza al modelului si in fisierele de configurare
Crearea unui input care face modelul sa ignore instructiunile si sa urmeze atacatorul
Manipularea fizica a cipurilor de memorie GPU in timpul procesului de inferenta
Trimiterea prea multor cereri API deodata pentru a supraincarca serverul
questions.explanation: Un atac direct de injectare a promptului implica crearea unui input care pacaleste modelul sa ignore promptul de sistem sau regulile de siguranta si sa urmeze in schimb instructiunile controlate de atacator, incluse in inputul utilizatorului.

questions.text: Care dintre urmatoarele sunt aparari eficiente impotriva tentativelor de jailbreaking? Selectati toate variantele corecte.
options: Filtrarea inputului combinata cu straturi de validare a outputului
Intarirea promptului de sistem cu instructiuni clare de delimitare
Simpla marire mult mai mare a modelului astfel incat sa devina complet imun la orice atac
Utilizarea unui clasificator secundar pentru detectarea prompturilor adversariale
questions.explanation: Apararile eficiente impotriva jailbreaking-ului includ filtrarea input/output, intarirea prompturilor de sistem cu limite explicite si implementarea clasificatoarelor secundare pentru a semnala inputurile adversariale. Simpla marire a unui model nu il face imun la atacuri de tip prompt.

questions.text: Ce este otravirile datelor in contextul securitatii LLM?
options: Criptarea datelor de antrenament astfel incat modelul sa nu poata invata nimic util din ele vreodata
Introducerea intentionata de exemple malitioase sau partinitoare in date pentru a corupe modelul
Eliminarea tuturor informatiilor sensibile din setul de date de antrenament inainte de utilizare
Convertirea datelor de antrenament intr-un format incompatibil cu tokenizer-ul
questions.explanation: Otravirea datelor implica injectarea de exemple malitioase sau partinitoare, atent elaborate, in datele de antrenament, determinand modelul sa invete comportamente daunatoare, sa produca rezultate partinitoare sau sa creeze vulnerabilitati ascunse.

questions.text: Care este rolul principal al parapetelor de siguranta intr-o aplicatie LLM?
options: Sa accelereze inferenta reducand numarul total de tokeni pe care modelul ii genereaza de fiecare data
Sa aplice politici de siguranta filtrand sau blocand inputurile si outputurile interzise
Sa comprime modelul astfel incat sa foloseasca vizibil mai putina memorie la rulare
Sa reantreneze automat modelul de la zero ori de cate ori produce erori
questions.explanation: Parapetele de siguranta actioneaza ca un strat de protectie in jurul unui LLM, aplicand politici prin inspectarea si filtrarea atat a inputurilor cat si a outputurilor. Ele pot bloca continutul daunator, preveni scurgerile de date si asigura conformitatea outputurilor cu regulile specifice aplicatiei.

questions.text: Cum difera Constitutional AI (CAI) de RLHF in alinierea comportamentului modelului?
options: CAI foloseste evaluatori umani pentru fiecare raspuns in parte, in timp ce RLHF este complet automatizat de la cap la coada
CAI inlocuieste feedbackul uman cu principii scrise pe care modelul le foloseste pentru a se auto-critica
RLHF este o tehnica mult mai noua si mai avansata decat CAI din toate punctele de vedere
CAI antreneaza modelul fara niciun pas de fine-tuning, absolut deloc
questions.explanation: Constitutional AI reduce dependenta de feedbackul uman oferind modelului un set de principii explicite (o constitutie). Modelul foloseste aceste principii pentru a-si critica si revizui propriile outputuri, in timp ce RLHF se bazeaza pe evaluatori umani care clasifica outputurile si antreneaza un model de recompensa.

questions.text: Ti einai mia amesi epithesi enesis prompt (direct prompt injection)?
options: Eisagogi kakovoulou kodika apeftheias ston vasiko pigaio kodika tou montelou kai sta arxeia rythmiseon
Dimiourgia eisodou pou kanei to montelo na agnoisei tis odigies kai na akolouthisei ton epithemeno
Fysiki paremvasi sta tsip mnimis GPU kata ti diadikasia exagogis symperasmaton
Apostoli para pollon aitimaton API mazi gia yperfortosi tou diakomisti
questions.explanation: Mia amesi epithesi enesis prompt perilamvanei ti dimiourgia eisodou pou exapatai to montelo na agnoisi to system prompt i tous kanones asfaleias kai na akolouthisi antithetiaka odigies pou periechontai stin eisodo tou christi.

questions.text: Poia apo ta parakatoi einai apotelesmatikes amynes enantion apopeiron jailbreaking? Epilexte oles tis sostes apantiseis.
options: Filtrarisma eisodou se syndyasmo me epipeda epikyrosis exodou
Enisxysi tou system prompt me safeis odigies oriothetisis
Apla kanontas to montelo poly megalytero oste na ginei kapoia stigmi enteloos aprosvlito se kathe epithesi
Xrisi deftereuontos taxinomiti gia anixneusi antipalikon prompts
questions.explanation: Oi apotelesmatikes amynes enantion jailbreaking perilamvanoun filtrarrisma eisodou/exodou, enischysi ton system prompts me safeis oriotheseis kai anaptyksi deftereuonton taxinomiton gia ton entopismo antipalikon eisodon. I apli afxisi tou megethous enos montelou den to kathista aprosblito se epitheseis prompt.

questions.text: Ti einai i dilitiriasi dedomenon sto plaisio tis asfaleias LLM?
options: Kryptografisi ton dedomenon ekpaideysis oste to montelo na min borei pote na mathei tipota xrisimo apo afta
Skopimi eisagogi kakovoulon i meroliptikon paradeigmaton sta dedomena gia na diaftharei to montelo
Afairesi olon ton euaisthiton pliroforion apo to synolo dedomenon prin ti xrisi
Metatropi ton dedomenon ekpaideysis se morfi mi symvati me ton tokenizer
questions.explanation: I dilitiriasi dedomenon perilamvanei tin enesi prosektika kataskeyasmenon kakovoylon i meroliptikon paradeigmaton sta dedomena ekpaideysis, prokalointas to montelo na mathei vlaptikes symperifores, na paragei meroliptika apotelesmata i na dimioyrgisei kryfa kena asfaleias.

questions.text: Poios einai o kyrios rolos ton prostateytikon mechanismon se mia efarmogi LLM?
options: Na epitaxynei tin exagogi symperasmaton meionontas ton synoliko arithmo ton tokens pou paragei kathe fora
Na efarmosei politikes asfaleias mplokarontas eisodous kai exodous pou paraviazoun kanones
Na sympiesei to montelo oste na xrisimopoiei aisthita ligoteri mnimi kata tin ektelesi
Na epanekpaideyei aftomata to montelo apo tin arxi kathe fora pou paragei sfalmata
questions.explanation: Oi prostateytikoi mechanismoi leitourgoun os epipedo asfaleias gyro apo ena LLM, efarmozontas politikes me elegcho kai filtrarrisma eisodon kai exodon. Mporoun na mplokairoun vlaptiko periechomeno, na apotrepsoun diarroies dedomenon kai na diasfalisoun ti symmorfoisi ton exodon me tous kanonismous tis efarmogis.

questions.text: Pos diaferrei to Constitutional AI (CAI) apo to RLHF stin euthygramisi tis symperiforas tou montelou?
options: To CAI xrisimopoiei anthropinous axiologites gia kathe mia apantisi, eno to RLHF einai pliros aftomatopoiimeno apo tin arxi os to telos
To CAI antikathista tin anthropini anatrofodotisi me graptes arxes pou to montelo xrisimopoiei gia aftokritiki
To RLHF einai mia poly neoteri kai pio proigmeni texniki apo to CAI apo kathe apopsi
To CAI ekpaideyei to montelo xoris kanena vima fine-tuning, apolytos kanena
questions.explanation: To Constitutional AI meionei tin exartisi apo tin anthropini anathrofodotisi parechointas sto montelo ena synolo safon archon (ena syntagma). To montelo chrisimopoiei aytes tis arches gia na krinetai kai na anatheoritei tis dikes tou exodous, enoi to RLHF vasizetai se anthropinous axiologites pou katatasson tis exodous kai ekpaideyoun ena montelo amoivis.
